title: Monthly attendance CSV export + backend-backed roll-call hooks

requirements.summary: Add a Monthly Export UI that downloads Excel-compatible monthly attendance CSV for the currently selected class/section.
acceptanceCriteria: From the app UI, the user can choose a month (and year if needed) and download a .csv file that opens correctly in Excel.

The exported CSV contains one row per student (or a clearly documented alternative, e.g., one row per student per day), and includes class, section, student name, roll number, and attendance values for the month.
If the user is not logged in/authorized, the export shows a clear English error message instead of downloading an empty or corrupt file.

file_operations.description: Add a Monthly Export panel (month/year input and Download CSV button) that uses the current AttendanceSession class/section and shows clear English authorization/errors. Use existing shadcn-ui primitives (e.g., Button/Card/Input/Alert) for consistent styling—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement CSV utilities (safe escaping/quoting, building rows, and triggering a browser download via Blob) to generate an Excel-compatible .csv file.
Create monthly attendance export helpers that transform (students + monthly roll-call data) into a CSV table format with English headers, including one row per student and day-of-month columns.

Add a small hook to orchestrate monthly export data fetching (students + monthly roll calls) and expose a single action for the Summary screen to generate/download CSV, including readable English errors on unauthorized access.

requirements.summary: Replace temporary localStorage roll-call hooks with backend-backed roll-call queries/mutations so attendance and export share the same source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Marking attendance and viewing the Summary uses backend-stored data for the selected day.
Refreshing the browser does not lose saved attendance for that day/month.
Monthly export uses the same backend source of truth as the Attendance/Summary screens.

file_operations.description: Replace localStorage implementation with backend calls via the actor: load daily roll call with getDailyRollCall and persist with submitRollCall; add a monthly query hook using getMonthlyRollCall (or the available monthly method) returning data needed for export.

Update AttendancePage to correctly map backend DailyRollCall data into the UI attendance record and to save using backend-backed useSaveRollCallForDay; ensure the saved payload aligns students to wasPresent flags deterministically.
Ensure SummaryPage calculations are based on backend roll-call data returned by the updated useGetRollCallForDay hook (no local-only behavior).
Add shared mapping helpers between UI attendance records and backend roll-call shapes (e.g., student ID list <-> wasPresent list) to keep Attendance and Export consistent.
